Scientific calculator, unit converter and currency converter for everyday math.

Calculator+ brings a scientific calculator, unit converter and currency converter together for everyday math, study, work and travel.

CALCULATE EVERYDAY AND SCIENTIFIC EXPRESSIONS
Work with arithmetic, parentheses, percentages, powers and square roots, then revisit saved results in calculation history.

CONVERT UNITS IN ONE PLACE
Convert length, area, mass, temperature, volume, speed, time and more. Search unit names and symbols to find the measurement you need, from cooking quantities to storage sizes.

COMPARE CURRENCIES
Choose currencies by name, country or currency code. Refresh exchange rates and check when they were last updated. Rates are for reference; actual transaction rates and fees may differ. Internet access is needed to refresh rates.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from app themes and adjust number formatting, key sounds and vibration in Settings.

UNDERSTAND WITH GRAPHY
See supported calculations explained as connected steps. Export Graphy diagrams as PDF or PNG.

RESTORE SAVED CALCULATIONS
Inspect saved results and reuse previous expressions from History.

TAKE A DAILY GAME BREAK
Open Play for hosted daily games. Internet access is required. Some themes and extra game sets are available through optional rewarded ads.

BMI: %1$s · Classification not recommended under 2. Use WHO weight-for-length assessment.

Under 2 years\nBMI-for-age classification is not recommended in this calculator. Infants should be assessed using WHO growth standards, including weight-for-length, with a healthcare professional. No adult category or weight target is shown.

Children and teens, ages 2–19\nCDC BMI-for-age categories depend on age in months and sex used by the growth reference. The BMI number alone cannot be compared with adult cutoffs. The reference range is not a weight-loss target; growth and health need professional assessment.

Adults, ages 20 and over\nCDC adult cutoffs apply regardless of age or sex. BMI is a screening measure, not a diagnosis, and does not distinguish muscle from fat. Older adults need interpretation alongside muscle mass, nutrition and overall health. Pregnancy requires different assessment.

Sources: CDC BMI categories and growth-reference data; CDC guidance on WHO infant growth standards. The CDC BMI-for-age reference population is the United States.

Enter amount, annual rate and duration.
Quarterly compounding · deposits at period start

Offline planning estimate using equal monthly periods, not actual-day bank accrual. Dates are anchored to the original day and clamped at month ends. Taxes, fees, penalties and missed deposits are excluded. Currency is a denomination, not an exchange conversion.

Investments occur at the beginning of each period. Monthly return is the stated annual percentage divided by 12. Step-up increases the previous monthly contribution after each selected interval, rounded to currency precision. Returns are estimates and are not guaranteed.
Quarterly compounding uses the equivalent monthly growth factor (1 + annual rate / 400)^(1/3). Every deposit is made at the beginning of its monthly period. Fractional-quarter values are estimates.

Cumulative deposits compound completed periods and earn proportional simple interest for any final partial period. Periodic deposits pay interest on unchanged principal without reinvestment. Periodic annual yield assumes hypothetical reinvestment at the same rate; actual payouts are not reinvested.
